verses.1: And Elohim said, “I will do it.”
verses.2: Hear my words, and they shall be your comfort.
verses.3: Take me along, and I will speak. After I speak, you can laugh.
verses.4: I am a man who is called by God’s name. But I don’t know why my heart isn’t filled with joy.
verses.5: Turn to me, and place your hands on my head.
verses.6: And if I remember and am frightened, and I grasp my own throat with fear.
verses.7: Why do the wicked live forever? They also grow old and die.
verses.8: Their descendants were present before them, along with their children.
verses.9: In their homes, there is peace from fear, and the Lord’s power no longer reigns over them.
verses.10: Let him go away, and let his hair not be touched or disturbed.
verses.11: Let them send their young ones out into the field, and let their children dance in the fields.
verses.12: They shall sing with a high voice, and rejoice in loud cries.
verses.13: They may live their good days, but in a moment of crisis, they will be destroyed.
verses.14: And they said to El, “Go away from us! We do not want to know your ways.”
verses.15: What a sad thing it is when they serve us, and what a painful thing it is when they are hurt.
verses.16: They do not have any good in their hands; their help is worthless, and they are far from me.
verses.17: How many wicked people you have destroyed! Their enemies will be defeated, and they will be scattered far away.
verses.18: They shall be written as if they were in front of the spirit, and as if they were stolen goods.
verses.19: May the Lord, who sees his children, reward him and know him.
verses.20: His eyes will be like those of a lion, and from the heat of the fire, he will be destroyed.
verses.21: For what does he desire in his house after his death? And from the number of his descendants, they were scattered.
verses.22: He will learn wisdom, and he will be able to rise above it.
verses.23: He died in a completely peaceful manner, just like Shalanan and Shaliyo.
verses.24: His breasts were filled with milk, and his muscles were strong.
verses.25: And he died in a miserable state, and he did not live a good life.
verses.26: Together, they will lie on the mountain; and a high cliff will cover them above.
verses.27: I also knew your thoughts and intentions towards me.
verses.28: For they will say, “Where is the house of the generous ones? Where is the dwelling place of the wicked?”
verses.29: Do not ask those who live along the roads; do not even notice them at all.
verses.30: For in that day, it will be evil for you; in the days to come, your actions will be wrong.
verses.31: Who will tell about his ways? Who will compensate him for what he’s done?
verses.32: And he was buried in Yubal, and over his grave, they laid spices.
verses.33: His feet were set on the banks of the river; behind him, everyone else also moved forward. And before him, there was no end to those who rushed forward.
verses.34: And how can you comfort me, O wretches, and your return will be unsuccessful.
